project.name: VozNativa
project.objective: PT-BR rewrite engine and Agent Skill with a deterministic semantic gate for candidate rewrites

audiences: AI coding agents running the Skill

platform.connectivity: offline by default; optional model provider

sensitive_data: user texts sent to a provider only when the user configures one

critical: meaning preservation (no false green in the semantic gate)

task.objective: Qualify and publish v0.8.0.dev0 as a GitHub pre-release (not stable, not PyPI) from a qualified main commit after one manual CI run
acceptance_criteria: the tagged commit is the one the CI run qualified
wheel, sdist and SHA-256 checksums attached
no result labelled human or independent unless it was

claims.statement: Local qualification gate passes on the release candidate
Semantic quality of rewrites is independently validated
False-green leads of the Assertiva dogfood were judged by negative controls
